title: Blackstone, La Caisse Acquire 25% Stake in Air Canada's Aeroplan
summary: Blackstone and a group led by Canada's La Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec have agreed to purchase a 25% stake in Air Canada's Aeroplan loyalty program. The deal is valued at $2.5 billion. This transaction involves the sale of a significant portion of the Aeroplan program by Air Canada to these investment firms.
summary_points: Blackstone and La Caisse de dépôt et placement du Québec will buy a 25% stake in Air Canada's Aeroplan.
The deal is valued at $2.5 billion.
Air Canada is selling this portion of its loyalty program.
The transaction involves investment firms acquiring a significant share of Aeroplan.
